title: Layer 2 round 3 minor security: cross_references tests build fixture trees at a predictable shared-temp path with a delete-then-create race — ride tempfile like the sibling suite

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: Fixed in 870836ce: TempProject holds a tempfile::TempDir (prefixed with the test name for debuggability) — unpredictable path, exclusive creation, RAII cleanup; the hand-rolled pid-named path, its delete-then-create race, and the Drop impl are gone. Matches the sibling shell suite's pattern.
